description.en: 把你能白嫖的模型额度接进 DSH 同一个池：WorkBuddy 多账号自动容错、十三家扫码登录、76 家免费额度聚合、用量看板、模型路由、本地 OpenAI 网关、积分自动化。
Manages the local Ubuntu user space with runtime install, reset, terminal, optional Shizuku shell access, and an embedded web UI.
description.zh: 管理本机 Ubuntu 用户空间，提供安装重置、终端、可选 Shizuku Shell 访问和内置网页界面。

description.en: Hardening guard for mcp__omni__parse in DeepSeek Harness: a tools/pre-execute listener that denies private/reserved host URLs (SSRF), enforces an allow-list or ask (consent), and is fail-closed when allowedRoots is empty.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 mcp__omni__parse 加固护栏：tools/pre-execute 监听器拒绝私网/保留主机（SSRF），施加白名单或 ask（同意），allowedRoots 为空时 fail-closed。

description.en: 一个Agent。让DeepSeek Herness变成AI写小说的工作区。这个项目也是DSH写的。
Select text in a DSH reply: a floating toolbar that quotes it into the composer draft or opens a side chat about it.
Project Memory gives coding agents a single, trustworthy memory for a software repository — so they stop re-learning the same facts and stop writing conflicting "memory" files.
description.zh: 给编程助手装一个仓库级长期记忆，避免重复摸索和记忆文件冲突，让AI协作更连贯高效。

description.en: YesPlayMusic controls and now-playing status for dsh-TUI
Two-phase long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-session extraction + global consolidation, always-injected summary, and memory_list/read/search/add tools.
Poppin'Party Live2D 桌宠插件 for DeepSeek Harness (local models, zero external deps)
Startup auto-updater for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): checks the npm registry once on boot and optionally installs newer versions.

Session-level threat scoring for the DeepSeek Harness: a port of the EntropyRuntime session threat tracker (PATCH-02) — sliding-window signal accumulation, three scoring rules, three levels — measuring and recording only by default, with an optional criti

Replaces the built-in bash executor so every command gets an environment resolved from its own working directory: configurable PATH prepends, Python venv activation and mise shims, with a dedicated section in the Web UI settings.
description.zh: 替换内置 bash 执行器，按每条命令的工作目录解析环境：可配置的 PATH 追加、Python venv 自动激活与 mise shims，并在 Web UI 设置中提供独立分区。

description.en: Harness-owned lifecycle for the dario proxy — starts it with your harness, readiness-gates it, and stops it when the harness stops, so subscription-backed (Claude/ChatGPT) model routes just work.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动并管理 dario 代理（把 Claude/ChatGPT 订阅当 API 用），就绪门控、随停随止，订阅模型路由开箱即用。

description.en: Connects dsh to the GreatArrow.ai MCP server over Streamable HTTP, so the agent can search and save workspace memories, tasks and decisions shared with your other AI clients; a config-only bundle that reads the token from great-arrow.token in the dsh home, never from the environment.
description.zh: 通过 Streamable HTTP 将 dsh 连接到 GreatArrow.ai MCP 服务器，让智能体检索和保存与你其他 AI 客户端共享的工作区记忆、任务与决策；纯配置包，从 dsh 主目录的 great-arrow.token 读取令牌，从不读取环境变量。

description.en: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review and knowledge distillation; roles are prompt-guided, not an automatic state machine.
description.zh: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

description.en: Bounded self-managed long-term memory (Hermes-style MEMORY.md / USER.md with hard character limits and a safety scan), a review that runs after every turn and writes plain-language notes or refines an existing skill instead of adding a near-duplicate, a curator that finds and surgically repairs skills the loader would silently discard, cross-session search over past messages, and a learning card above the composer that appears only when there is news and asks before it deletes or rewords a memory.
description.zh: 有界自管的长期记忆（Hermes 式 MEMORY.md / USER.md，硬字符上限 + 写入前安全扫描）；每轮结束后自动复盘，用大白话写笔记、或把新知识合并进已有技能而不堆出雷同技能；curator 找出会被加载器静默丢弃的技能并外科式修复；跨会话搜索历史消息；输入框上方的学习卡片只在有新闻时出现，删改记忆前必须先问你。

description.en: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.
description.zh: 在对话里直接调用本机或局域网的 ComfyUI 机队出图，支持工作流模板、机队健康检查与队列控制。

description.en: WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.
description.zh: 公众号发布管线：先按发布闸门校验草稿，再推送到草稿箱。

description.en: Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag documents that do not reconcile.
description.zh: 从文本中提取发票号码、日期、购销方、税号与金额/税额/合计，并验算「金额 + 税额 = 价税合计」是否成立，对不上就报出来。

description.en: Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.
description.zh: 把本机 ffmpeg 包成六个结构化工具：探流、转码裁剪、均匀抽帧、扒音轨，以及按目标体积做两遍编码压缩。

description.en: Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.
description.zh: 从图片或 PDF 中抽取文字，电子版直接读文字层，扫描件自动转交已配置的 OCR 引擎。

description.en: Read, write, convert and retime a subtitle track across SRT, WebVTT and ASS, audit it for over-long or unreadable cues, and transcribe audio through a configured speech recogniser.
description.zh: 读写互转 SRT/WebVTT/ASS 三种字幕并校正时间轴，出片前体检过长或读不过来的 cue，还能用已配置的识别引擎把音视频转成字幕。

description.en: Icon console for the DSH desktop app: import one icon and apply it to the desktop and Start Menu shortcuts (immediately), the application window image and the system tray image (after a restart), with automatic backup, one-click restore, a named icon library, and restart/exit controls.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端图标控制台：导入一个图标即可应用到桌面与开始菜单快捷方式（立即生效）、应用窗口图标与系统托盘图标（重启后生效），带官方图标自动备份、一键恢复、图标库管理，以及重启/退出控制。

description.en: Enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness — the official installer and registry for Scorp1o117's Vision, Soul/Persona, Memory & Marketplace plugins.
description.zh: Enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness — the official installer and registry for Scorp1o117's Vision, Soul/Persona, Memory & Marketplace plugins.
